titleLead: Everything you need to know about

cta.title: Another question?
cta.lead: Write to us or come and see the space for yourself: we reply quickly and arrange visits by appointment.

items.question: What facilities are available to coworkers?
items.answer: Fibre Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, a meeting room, lounge areas, a printer, lockers, self-service bikes and free parking around the building.

items.question: Can the meeting room host video conferences?
items.answer: Yes, the meeting room is equipped for hybrid meetings and video conferences, with a stable fibre connection and a shared screen on request.

items.question: Is the site accessible to people with reduced mobility?
items.answer: The building has step-free access and a lift. Do let us know your requirements when you visit so that we can support you as well as possible.

items.question: Do you organise events or opportunities for coworkers to meet?
items.answer: Welcome regularly hosts after-work gatherings, breakfasts and informal get-togethers to encourage professional connections and a friendly atmosphere.

items.question: What working solutions does Welcome Coworking offer?
items.answer: Three solutions: coworking in the open space for freelancers, enclosed private offices for teams, and meeting room rental by the hour or by the day. Kitchen, lounge area and fibre Wi-Fi are included.

items.question: Can I come and work for a single day or by the hour?
items.answer: Yes, the Nomad plan lets you book by the hour with no commitment, ideal for a one-off day or a few hours.

items.question: Are the private offices genuinely enclosed and secure?
items.answer: Yes, the private offices are fully enclosed spaces with 24/7 self-service access, where you can settle your team and your documents with complete peace of mind.

items.question: What is the minimum commitment for a private office?
items.answer: Private offices come with no minimum commitment, for maximum flexibility. Get in touch and we will look at the right arrangement for your team.

items.question: Can I use Welcome as my company's business address?
items.answer: Yes, depending on the plan you choose, Welcome can serve as your registered business address. Ask our team about the conditions.

items.question: Can I receive business post at Welcome?
items.answer: Yes, the plans generally include a business address and post handling. Contact us for the exact arrangements.

items.question: Where is the Welcome coworking space in Strasbourg?
items.answer: Welcome Coworking is at 204 avenue de Colmar, 67100 Strasbourg, by the Couffignal tram stop, with free parking, direct motorway access and an express cycle path into the city centre.

items.question: How do I get to Welcome from Strasbourg station?
items.answer: Take tram A or E towards Robertsau and get off at Couffignal, right at the foot of the building. Allow around 15 minutes from Strasbourg station.

items.question: Is there parking for coworkers and their visitors?
items.answer: Yes, parking is free around the building and easy to access, with direct links to the motorway and public transport.

items.question: Are there shops or restaurants nearby?
items.answer: The Robertsau district and the area around place de Haguenau offer bakeries, restaurants and shops a few minutes away on foot or by tram.

items.question: What are the access hours?
items.answer: Members have access to the space 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Introductory visits are by appointment, which you can request via the contact form, by phone on +33 6 22 80 55 36 or on WhatsApp.

items.question: Can I visit the space before committing?
items.answer: Yes. Visits are free and come with no obligation: you see the spaces, the atmosphere and the services, then choose the plan that suits your pace.

items.question: How do I book the meeting room?
items.answer: Bookings are made by phone, on WhatsApp or by email to contact@welcome-coworking.com. We will confirm availability and pricing promptly.

items.question: Can I occasionally bring in clients or colleagues?
items.answer: Yes, you can host your guests in the shared areas or in the meeting room. Simply let us know in advance so that we can welcome them properly.

items.question: How long has Welcome Coworking been running?
items.answer: Welcome Coworking has been hosting companies in Strasbourg since 2017 and has supported more than 100 businesses, freelancers and remote-working teams.

items.question: What is the quickest way to contact Welcome Coworking?
items.answer: By phone on +33 6 22 80 55 36, on WhatsApp, by email to contact@welcome-coworking.com, or directly via the contact form on this site.
